title: Add a Metric Group to a Linux (SNMP) device from the Device Catalogue

steps.action: Login as admin (admin/admin); onboard a device as Linux (SNMP) and open its Device Catalogue
steps.expected: Device is in inventory with type Linux (SNMP)

steps.action: Add / associate a new Metric Group
steps.expected: The Metric Group is created and associated successfully. This is the reported failure — currently the device type is absent from the supported mapping

title: Add a Metric Group to a Windows (SNMP) device from the Device Catalogue

steps.action: Onboard a device as Windows (SNMP) and open its Device Catalogue
steps.expected: Device is in inventory with type Windows (SNMP)

steps.action: Add / associate a new Metric Group
steps.expected: The Metric Group is created and associated successfully

title: Linux (SNMP) and Windows (SNMP) appear in the supported device-type list

steps.action: Open the device-type selector used when creating or assigning a Metric Group
steps.expected: Selector lists supported types

steps.action: Look for Linux (SNMP) and Windows (SNMP)
steps.expected: Both are present and selectable alongside the previously supported types

title: Test OID resolves for a Linux (SNMP) device

steps.action: While creating a Metric Group for a Linux (SNMP) device, use the test-OID facility
steps.expected: Test runs against the device

steps.action: Inspect the result
steps.expected: The device type is identified and the OID returns a value. The ticket states the test environment currently cannot identify these types for test OID

title: Test OID resolves for a Windows (SNMP) device

steps.action: While creating a Metric Group for a Windows (SNMP) device, use the test-OID facility
steps.expected: Test runs against the device

steps.action: Inspect the result
steps.expected: The device type is identified and the OID returns a value

title: SNMP device catalogue lookup returns a type for the new device types

steps.action: Inspect the SNMP device catalogue entry whose OID matches a Linux (SNMP) device
steps.expected: A catalogue row exists in the SNMP device catalog

steps.action: Verify the type resolution for that OID
steps.expected: getSNMPDeviceType(oid) returns the device type rather than null — the store matches on SNMP_DEVICE_CATALOG_OID case-insensitively and returns null when no row matches, which is the shape of the reported bug

title: Unknown OID still resolves to no type without erroring

steps.action: Query the catalogue with an OID that matches no catalogue row
steps.expected: Lookup completes

steps.action: Inspect the outcome
steps.expected: No type is returned and the caller degrades gracefully — no exception, no partial Metric Group created

title: OID matching is case-insensitive

steps.action: Query the catalogue with the same OID in differing case
steps.expected: Both lookups complete

steps.action: Compare results
steps.expected: Both resolve to the same device type — the store compares with equalsIgnoreCase

title: Metric Group assignment survives a config-template reference

steps.action: Associate a Metric Group with a Linux (SNMP) device via a config template
steps.expected: Association saved

steps.action: Re-open the config template
steps.expected: The catalogue id is retained in the template's multi-value catalog-ids reference; the association is not dropped on reload

title: Polling collects the new Metric Group for Linux (SNMP)

steps.action: Associate a Metric Group with a Linux (SNMP) device and wait for one poll cycle
steps.expected: Poll completes

steps.action: Open Metric Explorer for that device and counter
steps.expected: Data points are present for the newly associated group

title: Previously supported device types still accept Metric Groups

steps.action: Repeat the Metric Group association on a device type that already worked before this change (e.g. a network SNMP device)
steps.expected: Association succeeds

steps.action: Confirm behaviour
steps.expected: Unchanged — extending the mapping must not disturb existing types

title: Duplicate Metric Group name is rejected for the new device types

steps.action: Create a Metric Group for a Linux (SNMP) device reusing an existing group name
steps.expected: Submission attempted

steps.action: Inspect the result
steps.expected: A duplicate/not-unique validation error is shown and no second group is created

title: Metric Group create is rejected with a blank name or no counters

steps.action: Attempt to create a Metric Group for a Windows (SNMP) device with a blank name, then with no counters selected
steps.expected: Both submissions attempted

steps.action: Inspect the result
steps.expected: Each raises its own required-field validation; nothing is created

title: Invalid OID is rejected when adding a counter

steps.action: Add a counter to a Metric Group using a malformed OID (e.g. 1.3.6.1.abc) and test it
steps.expected: Test runs

steps.action: Inspect the result
steps.expected: A clear invalid-OID error is returned; the counter is not saved with an unusable OID

title: OID that the device does not expose fails clearly

steps.action: Test a well-formed OID that the Linux (SNMP) target does not implement
steps.expected: Test runs

steps.action: Inspect the result
steps.expected: A no-such-object / no-data error is reported rather than a silent success or a zero value

title: RBAC: a non-admin cannot create or assign Metric Groups

steps.action: Log in as a user whose role lacks metric-configuration rights and open a Linux (SNMP) device catalogue
steps.expected: Screen opens or is blocked per role

steps.action: Attempt to add a Metric Group
steps.expected: The action is unavailable or rejected; no group is created

title: XSS payload in a Metric Group name is neutralised

steps.action: Create a Metric Group named <script>alert(1)</script> for a Windows (SNMP) device
steps.expected: Submission attempted

steps.action: View the group in the catalogue and in Metric Explorer
steps.expected: Either validation rejects it or it renders escaped as literal text; no script executes

title: SNMP credential failure during test OID is reported distinguishably

steps.action: Point a Linux (SNMP) device at a wrong SNMP community and run test OID
steps.expected: Test runs

steps.action: Inspect the error
steps.expected: The message identifies a credential/authentication failure rather than a generic timeout — credential errors are a documented top cause of missing data

title: Unicode and long Metric Group names round-trip

steps.action: Create Metric Groups for a Linux (SNMP) device with a 255-character name and with a Devanagari name
steps.expected: Submissions attempted

steps.action: Reload the catalogue
steps.expected: Either both are accepted and display intact, or a clear max-length validation fires — no silent truncation or mojibake

title: Audit records Metric Group create and assignment

steps.action: Create and then assign a Metric Group to a Linux (SNMP) device
steps.expected: Both actions complete

steps.action: Open the audit trail
steps.expected: Separate records exist for create and assign, naming the actor, the device and the timestamp

title: Upgrade path adds the mapping for existing installs

steps.action: Upgrade an install that already has Linux (SNMP) and Windows (SNMP) devices onboarded
steps.expected: Upgrade completes

steps.action: Open the Device Catalogue for one of those pre-existing devices
steps.expected: Metric Groups can now be added without re-onboarding — the mapping is applied by patch, consistent with how metric-group attachment patches ship
